channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Marc Eversley | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Marc Eversley from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Michael Reinsdorf on Marc Eversley, Arturas Karnisovas, Devin Booker
item.description:
“Zach had been on some bad teams, and just like it wasn't Devin Booker's fault in Phoenix for those years, it wasn't Zach's fault here. We needed to get him help. Billy, Arturas and (general manager) Marc Eversley spend a lot of time with our players. These aren't assets, these are people. But especially with Zach, they took time to understand what he is all about. It was easy for people on the outside to say,”

Michael Reinsdorf on Marc Eversley, Arturas Karnisovas, Devin Booker, Jan 14, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Wendell Carter Jr on Marc Eversley
item.description:
He’s just acknowledging that when the easily spouted sound bite becomes a reality, the business of basketball is no joke.

“It was about 30 minutes before the trade deadline. I got the call from AK and Marc (Eversley),”

Wendell Carter Jr on Marc Eversley, Nov 26, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on Marc Eversley
item.description:
Rob Schaefer:DeMar DeRozan on Marc Eversley:

“He played a part in drafting my to Toronto… He was one of the first guys to see me work out.”

DeMar DeRozan on Marc Eversley, Aug 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @rob_schaef.

item.title: Arturas Karnisovas on Marc Eversley
item.description:
Karnisovas on Eversley:

“I will use a lot of his ideas. In many ways, his values are close to mine. We value inclusion of staff. We will emphasize transparency and communication. At end of day, we're both basketball junkies.”

Arturas Karnisovas on Marc Eversley, May 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.
